'''X10-700 "Destroyer"''' was the designation of a [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighter]] that used a [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] chassis. It was a member of the [[Detritus Satellites]], a group of scavenger [[Droid/Legends|droids]], mostly [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|''Vulture''-class droid starfighters]], operating in the [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine system]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:JtL" /> By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Detritus Satellites formed an alliance with the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate. X10-700 "Destroyer" and [[Tvinnii Blackrunn]] were the signers of the alliance agreement.<ref name="SWG:AAA" />

==Behind the scenes==
X10-700 "Destroyer" appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:JtL" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

X10-700 "Destroyer" was added to the game with the first expansion pack, ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|Jump to Lightspeed]]'', released on [[October 27]], [[2004]]. X10-700 was the only member of the Detritus Satellites that was not a Vulture droid.<ref name="SWG:JtL" /> In space battles, rare information storage devices can sometimes be [[Wikipedia:Looting (gaming)|looted]] from destroyed starfighters. One of these datapads, named "[[W:c:swg:An Alliance Agreement|An Alliance Agreement]]," can be found in the Dantooine system and contains the text of an agreement, signed by X10-700 "Destroyer".<ref name="SWG:AAA" />
